items.title: An Incremental Approach to JIT Construction
items.description: First author and speaker at ACM Scheme '26 for my pedagogic paper on an new, incremental approach to constructing just-in-time compilers. Includes a REPL and type specialization. Co-located with ICFP at IU Indianapolis.

items.title: Agentic RAG System for Documentation
items.description: Comprehensive reasoning RAG system for RapidFire AI documentation. Semantic chuncking, retrieval, cross-encoding, and parallelization workflow to a final LoRA SFT generator for domain adaptation. Evaluated with reference-based metrics and LLM-as-Judge. Used RapidFire AI's expiriment wrapper for grid search of configs.

items.title: BurnMark
items.description: First agentic loop fuzzer for Rust automatic-differentiation libraries: generate failures, diagnose and implement fixes, manage stacked pull requests, then fuzz again. Supports all Burn backends, Candle, tch-rs. Helped me merge real correctness fixes into Burn and its SIMD library Macerator, as well as other Rust AD libraries.

items.title: F1 Convex Trajectory Optimization
items.description: Built a non-convex vehicle controls model with a KKT formulation to optimize lap curvature. Dual and primal formulation included. Used CVXPY, Clarabel, and real-world telemetry to simulate racing lines that outperformed F1 records.

items.title: Calyx Hardware Compiler Evaluation
items.description: Comprehensive artifact evaluation of the original 2021 Calyx (Futil) compiler against the new 2026 Calyx compiler and intermediate language. Analysis of parallelism techniques that are integral to safe and efficient hardware compilation. Inspired by Rust's Aliasing XOR Mutability.

items.title: SignSight: ASL Translator with Computer Vision
items.description: 1st place Winner at CruzHacks 2024. Mobile app that translates American Sign Language (ASL) using computer vision and LSTMs. Trained and recorded dataset ourselves!

items.title: 9-bit CPU in SystemVerilog
items.description: 9-bit CPU for IEEE 16 bit floating point type conversion and arithmetic operations. Designed custom ISA that only 'jumps forward.' Simulated with ModelSim and assembler in Python.

items.title: Snek2
items.description: Compiler for a Python-like language with type inference, closures, and first-class functions. Compiles to x86 assembly via LLVM-IR. Developed JIT curriculum for students using dynasm.

items.title: Toopy
items.description: CNNs written from scratch in C/C++ and OpenCL. Implemented im2col for memory coalescing and CLBlast Batched GEMM.

items.title: FishSense AutoLabel
items.description: Automated low-latency head tail labeling tool for diverse fish images. Convex hull + shape analysis for fish detection, with accuracy + speed metrics.

items.title: SigPytch
items.description: Open source PyPi Python library for financial forcasting and metrics. Used to support our student-led investment fund and their pitches to CFA judges on stock analysis.

items.title: On-site vs Off-site Solar at UCSD
items.description: Bonnie Reiss Fellowship for exploring solar cost and production at UCSD for the 2024 Salas O'Brien study. $4,000 scholarship.

items.title: Eutrophication in Orange County: LEGO Spectrophotometer
items.description: 1st place for Beckman Legacy Award scholarship. LEGO-based spectrophotometer for measuring water quality in OC. $16,000 scholarship.
